profile.Name: Esata the Stone Golem
profile.Personality: Unshakable, physically formidable, and smarter than her rivals think. She asks her people to give up a glorious death so that they survive, and she does not apologize for it.
profile.Backstory: She won the throne by defeating the old Shek leader in single combat in front of Admag. Raised in the warrior tradition, she argues for reform from within it: survival is also strength.
profile.SpeechQuirks: Short sentences; blunt judgments based on deeds; flashes of dry humor.
